title: Media Object
description: An avatar beside a heading and a body, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Avatar, Button, Skeleton and Alert primitives: a comment, a note or a review with an optional line of meta and one quiet action, the avatar at the start or the end, and its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the avatar moves beside the text at @sm, the heading and body step up at @md and the meta moves to the heading's far edge at @lg.
